cv_sections.summary:
I'm a passionate electronics design engineer with over 6 years of
experience crafting innovative hardware systems. I thrive on complex
integration challenges and collaborate with industry leaders to push
technological boundaries. My expertise in protocols helps bridge
gaps between different systems, turning ambitious ideas into reality.
Nothing excites me more than seeing a concept transform from
sketches to functional technology. I maintain an active network
of industry professionals and stay current with emerging trends,
bringing fresh insights to every project I undertake. This blend
of technical precision and creative problem-solving drives my
contributions to the field.
I oversee the entire development process, starting from concept
creation, through design and prototyping, to testing, validation,
and final delivery. This includes managing each stage to ensure
seamless integration and successful project completion.
I have successfully completed projects in high-reliability fields,
contributing to innovation and growth. 
I am a dedicated researcher and lifelong learner, always eager to
explore new technologies and improve my skills.

• Utilized advanced simulation tools for SI,PI, Thermal, circuit design and
validation using HyperLynx, PDN by Keysight, LTspice, Cadence Pspice, TI
WEBENCH, Infineon Designer, Polar, Saturn PCB Toolkit, ..etc.
• Designing an IoT gateway that includes wireless communications LTE (U-
blox), Wi-Fi (ESP32-S3), and LoRa (STM32WL), with optimized antenna
design and placement. The gateway is battery-based utilizing a UPS circuit,
has a small form factor, and is optimized for low cost.
• Designing an IoT sensors LoRa protocol based, optimized to meet ultra-
low power application, archiving 5uA current consumption with full functional
sensor in standby mode.
